photos.c: Left: Jason Lobo leads the Gold Cup 1500 metres mid-way through the race. He eventually placed 2nd to Kevin McKay (Sale) pictured here close up behind the Belgrave man. Jason finished the season with best 1998 performances of 49.6/ 1:47.48/3:48.90 for 400m through 1500m.
